channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Common preservative linked to rising suicide rates among youth
item.description: A common food preservative is emerging as a concerning factor in rising UK suicide deaths, especially among younger people.

item.title: Old theory about ants, bees, and wasps may be incorrect
item.description: A long-held theory about a genetic system in social insects may be wrong. A new large-scale analysis challenges previous assumptions.

item.title: Ancient sea monster bones discovered in 30-year-old fossil
item.description: Fossils collected in Osaka over 30 years ago have revealed four previously unrecognized bones from a giant Cretaceous-era sea creature.

item.title: Brain receptor switch explains opposing weight loss effects
item.description: Scientists have uncovered why two opposite ways of targeting the same brain receptor can both promote weight loss in mice.
